# Test font

`DejaVuSans.ttf` is DejaVu Sans 2.37, used only by the geometry tests (text cases in
`tests/geometry`). It is test data and is not part of the program.

- Source: https://github.com/dejavu-fonts/dejavu-fonts/releases/tag/version_2_37
  (`dejavu-fonts-ttf-2.37.tar.bz2`, SHA-256 `fa9ca4d13871dd122f61258a80d01751d603b4d3ee14095d65453b4e846e17d7`)
- License: Bitstream Vera license plus public-domain changes, see `LICENSE-DejaVu.txt`.
  The file is unmodified.
